Shun war criminals
2013-07-07T01:02:24+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/shun-war-criminals

Leaders of Sector Commanders Forum (SCF) yesterday urged all political parties to refrain from having any sort of ties with war criminals.

They also urged the public not to allow war criminals to participate in elections, and even if they do the public should not vote for the criminals.

Sector Commanders Forum Chairman Air Vice Marshal (retd) AK Khandker said people should be aware that not a single war criminal can enter the parliament.

He was addressing a national conference of SCF's representatives at Chattagram Samity office in the capital.

AK Khandker said politics of Jamaat-e-Islami and Jamaat backed Islami Chhatra Shibir should be banned to stop the use of religion in politics.

Former Army chief Maj Gen (retd) KM Shafiullah, Bir Bikram stressed the need for more integration among the organisation's members so that they are more effective in resisting anti-liberation forces.

Hefajat-e Islam, Jamaat and Shibir will become more violent in the coming days and strong coordination is needed among pro-liberation forces to tackle them, he added.
